summary: The method predicate accepted space and invalid HTTP token delimiters, allowing a request beginning with " GET" to parse successfully. The fix checks HTTP token characters using an uppercase-letter fast path and TOKEN_MAP, rejecting the leading space with Error::Token. Reversing only the predicate body restores the original behavior while preserving the upstream regression test added by this fix. No tests were run.
